title: Jeffrey Kripal's MIT lecture on flying saints, attended by a Skunk Works R&D head

tellings.quote: He was giving a lecture on flying saints at MIT.

related.note: Kripal speaking on levitation or flying saints to a Lockheed revolutionary-technology head. This is the same subject as the story of the levitation talk to Lockheed engineers, but here it is a public MIT lecture the head attended, not a private talk he asked for.

plain: A scholar named Jeffrey Kripal gave a lecture at MIT on flying saints, stories of holy people said to rise into the air, and the audience included the unnamed head of revolutionary technologies at Lockheed Martin's Skunk Works, its secret advanced-aircraft division. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source. It would mean that top aerospace engineers take old stories of levitation seriously.
